Star Trek - Starfleet Academy - Starship.name: Star Trek: Starfleet Academy - Starship Bridge Simulator
Star Trek - Starfleet Academy - Starship.summary: The game is viewed from the bridge of your vessel (there are 5 different ones in total), with polygons used to display the action. Information on the world situation at the time of the game is supplied within the game. There are quick missions bringing scenes from Star Trek movies to life.
